title: Freshness at lookup: revalidation counts, memos, ledger reads and status agree
goal: A stale-only revalidation keeps a row's full citation count, not the due sources'; a page or search answer that is a network failure or a 200 without the result list is an unanswered use in every memo hit, never not found; a fact whose window enters a next section is compared by every section it enters without cached previous text; fetch.py --status stale is exactly what a lookup revalidates (kbfacts.source_freshness); the scoped ledger row read returns a full csv read's rows for quoted quotes and a last-column key; a kb MCP session in a worktree reads that worktree's kb, not the main checkout's
